entries.title: Job 27:1
segments: ¶Moreover Job continued his parable, and said, {continued: Heb. added to take up}

entries.title: Job 27:2
segments: [As] God liveth, [who] hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, [who] hath vexed my soul; {vexed...: Heb. made my soul bitter}

entries.title: Job 27:3
segments: All the while my breath [is] in me, and the spirit of God [is] in my nostrils; {the spirit...: that is, the breath which God gave him}

words.text: ; {the spirit...: that is, the breath which God gave him}

entries.title: Job 27:4
segments: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

entries.title: Job 27:5
segments: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

entries.title: Job 27:6
segments: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach [me] so long as I live. {so long...: Heb. from my days}

words.text: fast, and will not let it go

entries.title: Job 27:7
segments: ¶Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

entries.title: Job 27:8
segments: For what [is] the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

entries.title: Job 27:9
segments: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

entries.title: Job 27:10
segments: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

entries.title: Job 27:11
segments: ¶I will teach you by the hand of God: [that] which [is] with the Almighty will I not conceal. {by...: or, being in the hand, etc}

words.text: . {by...: or, being in the hand, etc}

entries.title: Job 27:12
segments: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen [it]; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

words.text: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen
[it]; why then are ye thus altogether

entries.title: Job 27:13
segments: This [is] the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, [which] they shall receive of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 27:14
segments: If his children be multiplied, [it is] for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Job 27:15
segments: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

entries.title: Job 27:16
segments: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

entries.title: Job 27:17
segments: He may prepare [it], but the just shall put [it] on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

entries.title: Job 27:18
segments: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth [that] the keeper maketh.

entries.title: Job 27:19
segments: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he [is] not.

words.text: , but he shall not be gathered

entries.title: Job 27:20
segments: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

entries.title: Job 27:21
segments: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

entries.title: Job 27:22
segments: For [God] shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand. {he...: Heb. in fleeing he would flee}

words.text: . {he...: Heb. in fleeing he would flee}

entries.title: Job 27:23
segments: [Men] shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
